name: SkyCollection
description: Personalize the save-specific item catalog and reset its discovered records.

settings.label: Show plugin names
settings.description: Show the plugin that owns each item record.

settings.label: Show collected item counts
settings.description: Show how many copies you have collected.

settings.label: Show item subcategory names
